does_not_cover: Title promises the geometry of changing beliefs, yet the treasure-hunt and AI applications are name-dropped only, never worked through with numbers.
No confusion matrix, classification metric, histogram, or sampling-bias discussion appears despite the L01 header; the video stays inside one toy counting example.
The 1x1-square diagram is sketched qualitatively; no continuous distribution or real dataset is ever mapped onto it.
notes: Brisk popular exposition, prerequisites none beyond fractions; prior/likelihood/posterior vocabulary introduced cleanly. Representative-sample counting overlaps L02 sampling ideas but stays at L01 level.
